title: Test code and evidence boundaries
description: Read test implementations test/test_models.py, test/test_tools.py, test/test_utils.py. Identify the behavior each assertion encodes, connect it to implementation, and distinguish a test file from an executed passing result. The test/configuration evidence is traced into implementation rrmpg/models/__init__.py.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in test/test_models.py, test/test_tools.py, test/test_utils.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for test/test_models.py, test/test_tools.py, test/test_utils.py
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
